title: Page View Seasonality
scenario: Identify categories where views in the last quarter were significantly different (>= 50%) from the previous quarter.
tableSchema: categories (category_id INT), articles (article_id INT, category_id INT), page_views (article_id INT, view_date DATE, views_count INT)
hint: Compare sums per quarter using LAG().
correctQuery: SELECT category_id FROM (SELECT category_id, qtr, sum_v, LAG(sum_v) OVER(PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY qtr) as prev_q FROM (SELECT category_id, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', view_date) as qtr, SUM(views_count) as sum_v FROM articles JOIN page_views USING (article_id) GROUP BY category_id, qtr) t) t2 WHERE ABS(sum_v - prev_q) / prev_q >= 0.5;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE categories (category_id INT); CREATE TABLE articles (article_id INT, category_id INT); CREATE TABLE page_views (article_id INT, view_date DATE, views_count INT);
